message:
I’ll never forget the night of that unexpected blackout. My friend Sarah called me in a total tizzy, convinced the world was ending because the lights went out. Meanwhile, I was just cozying up with my flashlights and a good book, thinking, "Hey, a little quiet time never hurt anyone!" 

I reminded her that it’s just a temporary hiccup, and with a few power banks charged and a lantern ready, we could enjoy a little adventure. It turned into a fun evening of storytelling by flashlight, and by the end, she was laughing at her own panic. 

It’s funny how we can go from chaos to comfort with just a little preparedness. Anyone else have a friend who tends to panic? What’s your go-to tip for keeping the calm during a blackout? 😊
